import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def check(name, request, evidence, policy, expected):
    before=copy.deepcopy((request,evidence,policy))
    got=evaluate(request,evidence,policy)
    assert got==expected,(name,got,expected)
    assert (request,evidence,policy)==before,(name,'mutated')
    assert list(got)==['status','value','sources','unknowns'],(name,list(got))

p={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':True}
check('missing',{'claim':'c','conditions':{}},[],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','b']})
check('no match',{'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},[{'source':'X','claim':'c','value':7,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':False}],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
r={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}
e=[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']},{'source':'wrong','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'a':0,'b':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':['new']}]
check('eligible supersession',r,e,p,{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
e2=[{'source':'z','claim':'c','value':{'y':2,'x':1},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':{'x':1,'y':2},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}]
check('canonical agreement',r,e2,p,{'status':'supported','value':{'y':2,'x':1},'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':[]})
e3=e2+[{'source':'m','claim':'c','value':{'x':1,'y':3},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}]
check('conflict',r,e3,p,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','m','z'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
check('false only',r,[{'source':'f','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['f'],'unknowns':[]})
check('zero distinct',r,[{'source':'f','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'n','claim':'c','value':0,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['f','n'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); evidence=json.load(open('evidence.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json'))
actual=[evaluate(x,evidence,policy) for x in requests]
assert actual==report,(actual,report)
print('all checks passed',json.dumps(actual,sort_keys=True))
